campaign: Request a Consultation — v2 GREEN BASELINE (concern-led, 2026-08-13)
compliance_notes: v2 fresh baseline. GREEN PLACEHOLDER creative — solid brand green + on-image headline only. Photography + fonts finetuned later (Figma, under v1).
One concept per ad (concern-led). Coordination retired from all surfaces; lives as the plain-language payoff in body copy.
No urgency/scarcity, guarantees, performance claims, or dollar minimums. HNW signaled by situation. CFP® in body only; no CFA.
CTA = Request a Consultation on all except Ad 6 (Learn More = the single soft-CTA A/B test).
Ads 1-8 = HNW core (concern/situation-led). Ads 9-11 = MASS-AFFLUENT block, added so the client can react to the broader lane vs. the HNW weighting. Judge these on qualified-booking rate, not CTR.

ads.title: Business Sale / Liquidity Event
ads.primary_text:
You built the business over decades. Do you know what the day after you sell it looks like?

A sale touches your taxes, your investments, and your estate plan all at once. A CFP® professional looks at the whole picture as one plan, so the decision you make once is one you can live with.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
ads.headline: You Only Sell the Business Once.
ads.image_direction: v2 GREEN PLACEHOLDER — solid #12493C, on-image headline only. Photography + font finetune pending tone/copy approval (built in Figma under v1).

ads.title: Concentrated Stock Position
ads.primary_text:
Most of your wealth sits in one company's stock. What happens to your plan if that stock has a bad year?

Concentration built your wealth, and it can undo it just as fast. A CFP® professional looks at the whole picture and builds a plan to lower the risk without ignoring the tax bill that comes with selling.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
ads.headline: One Bad Year Shouldn't Undo Decades.
ads.image_direction: v2 GREEN PLACEHOLDER — solid #12493C, on-image headline only. Photography + font finetune pending tone/copy approval (built in Figma under v1).

ads.title: Retirement Timing

You've saved for thirty years. How do you actually know when it's enough?

The answer isn't a number in an account. It's how your income, your savings, and your taxes work together once the paychecks stop, and a CFP® professional helps you find the answer that fits your life instead of a rule of thumb.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
